name: PoleLine
subtitle: Draw the lap. Take pole.
shortDescription: Draw your racing line and watch the car run it. Twenty circuits, all offline.
description:
A great lap starts with a line.

Pick your tyres, draw your racing line around the circuit with one finger, and watch a modern single-seater drive exactly that line in real time: live sectors, gear, revs, active aero, battery and tyre temperature. Then read the result. Which sector cost you? Did the softs overheat? Did the battery clip early? Draw again.

Twenty circuits of your own
From the tight streets of Harbour Loop to the long, cold sweeps of Aurora Point: street circuits at night, fast parks, hairpins, esses and a short club circuit. Each one has its own locked conditions, so every lap is comparable. A guided first lap on the Rookie Ring teaches the game in a minute, and you can pause it to change how you draw.

Your line is the lap
Draw it your way. Easy: tap the track and bend the curves. Medium: draw freely and each stroke is tidied into a racing line. Hard: every inch is yours, and the white line stops you. The car cannot follow a wobble, so a smooth, wide entry and a clipped apex beat a short cut. Pole pace, a grid slot from P1 to P20 and a race engineer's note tell you where the time is.

Your times, your device
Your ten quickest laps on every circuit stay on your phone with their lines. Watch any of them again against your best, and reuse the drawing setup it was set with. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics and no internet connection. The only permission it uses is vibration.

Pick your car's colours from nine teams, or keep the PoleLine purple.

PoleLine is a Toyboxes game by Randroid LLC.
releaseNotes: First release: twenty circuits, three ways to draw your racing line from easy to hard, tyre strategy, your ten quickest laps per circuit with replays, a guided first lap, and nothing that needs a connection.
playReleaseNotes: New in this update: three ways to draw your racing line. Easy lays it as curves you tap and bend, medium tidies each stroke into a racing line, and hard is pure freehand. Pick one on the tutorial's welcome card or any time in Settings. The lap now closes cleanly when your last curve or stroke lands on the start point.
reviewNotes: No login or network connection is needed. The first launch opens a guided lap on the Rookie Ring; its welcome card offers Easy, Medium or Hard (Easy is picked, and Skip is available). Then pick a circuit, tap Draw a lap, choose a tyre and touch the chequered line. On Easy, tap the track ahead to lay curves and tap further on or Set curve; on Medium and Hard, drag along the road, lift, and carry on from the purple tip. The car runs the line when the loop closes. Your times are stored on the device. This is a paid download without ads or in-app purchases.
